snapshot.text: Luxembourg runs a centralised statutory health insurance system with near-universal coverage and free choice of providers, and public funding above 85%. Key challenges are workforce shortages, reliance on foreign-trained staff, and sustainability. Care is shifting toward outpatient settings.

minister.name: Martine Deprez
minister.role: Minister of Health and Social Security

priorities.title: Ambulatory care legal reform
priorities.text: A draft bill would extend the hospital law to outpatient facilities, implementing the 2023–2028 coalition commitment to expand ambulatory care's role.

priorities.title: Planned health check-up programme
priorities.text: A regular health check-up programme is planned, with a pilot phase scheduled for 2027, alongside attention to sex differences in cardiovascular care.

priorities.title: Stronger international health cooperation
priorities.text: At WHO/Europe's 2026 Regional Committee, Luxembourg urged less fragmentation in global health architecture without new coordination mechanisms.

netherlands.text: Luxembourg and the Netherlands both participate in Beneluxa, a joint initiative on faster access to innovative medicines through shared price negotiations.
